tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Scan a public website and return an AI-readiness score (0-100), sub-scores, AI-bot robots.txt access, and a list of issues with concrete fixes. Use when a user asks if a site is visible/optimized for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini or AI search.

tools.name: check_bot_access
tools.description: Check whether a site's robots.txt allows or blocks AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended). Optionally limit the answer to one bot. Note: only robots.txt is checked; a firewall may still block a bot.
